description: Dataforsyningen (Danish data supply portal for elevation, map and address data) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Danish Agency for Data Supply and Infrastructure. Search summaries describe the portal as the access point for Danish national map data, among them the Danish elevation model (DHM), a lidar-derived terrain and surface model of the whole country at up to 40 cm resolution that municipalities and emergency services use to assess flood paths, available for download and through WMS, WFS, WMTS and REST interfaces. Coverage: Denmark. Formats and interfaces named: WMS, WFS, API. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the page text could not be read, so the data list, interfaces and terms come from search summaries and are unverified; a user token may be needed for services. It can support terrain and flood-path inputs for drainage, road and utility studies in Denmark. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
